comments.author: Regna
comments.body: Usually ppl complain about how hard it is pull certain quests in comment section but not this one. Well, just so you know, this is a rare quest as well. Burned about a 100 of them.

comments.author: Yihwa
comments.body: From past experiences, the quests that are part of a chain tend to be tougher to pull than most. Of course, your mileage may vary. Thankfully, it's quite cheap to buy QMPs from the Adventure Guild Shop, so you can burn through them like firewood going through these chains :)
